title: Closed-Loop Orchestration Contract
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool orchestrate`, coordinating all 4 cognitive stages across the cluster in a single invocation. The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

StageExecution.description: Telemetry and execution status for an individual stage in the cognitive cycle.

stage_index.description: Index of the cognitive stage (1 = filter, 2 = recall, 3 = deliberate, 4 = consolidate).

status.description: Stage status (e.g. ok, skipped, degraded, error).

error.description: Error details if the stage degraded or failed.

request.description: Parameters for closed-loop orchestration populated via CLI flags.

input.description: Raw incoming sensory string or stream line (CLI flag --input).

directive.description: Attention directive guiding filtering and deliberation (CLI flag --directive).

trace_id.description: Optional distributed trace ID for cross-node correlation (CLI flag --trace-id).

sync.description: When true, executes Stage 4 consolidation synchronously (CLI flag --sync).

response.description: Consolidated response encapsulating telemetry and results across all 4 cognitive stages.

trace_id.description: The distributed trace identifier correlated across all hops.

status.description: Overall cognitive cycle outcome (e.g. success, partial_failure, error).

stages.description: Ordered per-stage execution status and latency metrics.

deliberate.description: Results from Stage 3 Working Memory Deliberation.

total_latency_ms.description: Total roundtrip latency of the 4-stage cognitive loop in milliseconds.

total_duration_ms.description: Alternative key for total duration in milliseconds.
